grammar_points.title: 现在完成时
grammar_points.summary: 强调过去发生的事与现在的联系，而不是动作本身的时间。
grammar_points.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar_points.explanation: 现在完成时把注意力放在「结果或经历」上。与一般过去时不同，它不交代具体时间点，因此常与 already、yet、ever、since、for 连用。当句子出现明确的过去时间（yesterday、in 2020）时，必须改用一般过去时。

grammar_points.title: 一般过去时
grammar_points.summary: 描述在过去某个明确时间发生并结束的动作。
grammar_points.explanation: 一般过去时需要一个可识别的时间参照：yesterday、last week、two days ago、when I was a child。它关注「动作发生过」，不关注对现在的影响。

grammar_points.title: 定语从句
grammar_points.summary: 用 who/which/that/whose/where 把一句话变成名词的修饰成分。
grammar_points.structure: 名词 + 关系词 + 从句
grammar_points.explanation: 限定性定语从句紧跟先行词，不用逗号；非限定性定语从句用逗号隔开，且不能用 that。关系词在从句中作宾语时可以省略，作主语时不可省略。

grammar_points.title: 被动语态
grammar_points.summary: 动作承受者作主语，强调「被怎样」，弱化执行者。
grammar_points.structure: 主语 + be + 过去分词 (+ by ...)
grammar_points.explanation: 学术与工作场景中，被动语态让表达更客观。be 的时态决定整句时间，过去分词决定动作。只有及物动词可以变被动。

grammar_points.title: 比较级与最高级
grammar_points.summary: 比较两者用 -er/more，比较三者及以上用 -est/most。
grammar_points.structure: A + 比较级 + than + B；the + 最高级 + in/of 范围
grammar_points.explanation: 单音节词通常加 -er/-est，三音节及以上用 more/most。避免双重比较（more better），也避免在同一句里既用 than 又用最高级。

grammar_points.title: 情态动词
grammar_points.summary: can/may/must/should 表达能力、许可、推测与义务，后接动词原形。
grammar_points.structure: 主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形
grammar_points.explanation: 情态动词不随人称变化，也没有 to。表达推测时，must 表示「一定」，can't 表示「不可能」，may/might 表示「也许」。过去推测用 情态动词 + have + 过去分词。

grammar_points.title: 冠词的使用
grammar_points.summary: a/an 引入一个新的可数名词，the 指向双方已知的那一个。
grammar_points.structure: a/an + 可数名词单数；the + 特指名词
grammar_points.explanation: 第一次提到用 a/an，再次提到用 the。独一无二的事物、序数词、最高级前用 the。表示泛指复数的可数名词与不可数名词前不加冠词。

grammar_points.title: 动词不定式
grammar_points.summary: to + 动词原形，可在句中作主语、宾语、目的状语或补语。
grammar_points.explanation: 部分动词后只能接不定式（decide、hope、refuse、be reluctant to），部分只能接动名词（enjoy、avoid、finish）。表示目的时，不定式前不加 for。

grammar_points.title: 介词短语
grammar_points.summary: 介词 + 名词/动名词，用来补充时间、地点、原因与方式。
grammar_points.structure: 介词 + 名词短语 / 动名词
grammar_points.explanation: 固定搭配需要整体记忆：in light of、on behalf of、regardless of、in terms of。介词后接动词时必须用动名词。

grammar_points.title: 句子结构与连接
grammar_points.summary: 避免逗号粘连与流水句，用连接词标明分句之间的逻辑关系。
grammar_points.structure: 主句 + 连接词 + 分句（或使用分号 / 关系从句）
grammar_points.explanation: 两个完整句子不能只用逗号连接。可用并列连词（and、but、so）、从属连词（because、although、while）或分号。学术写作中，逻辑连接词要和内容真实对应，不能滥用。

grammar_examples.en: I have reviewed this list three times.
grammar_examples.zh: 这份清单我已经复习过三遍。

grammar_examples.en: She has lived in Shanghai since 2019.
grammar_examples.zh: 她自 2019 年起就住在上海。

grammar_examples.en: The app has become much faster.
grammar_examples.zh: 这个应用已经快了很多。

grammar_examples.en: She contemplated the question for a while.
grammar_examples.zh: 她思考了这个问题一会儿。

grammar_examples.en: We started using this method last month.
grammar_examples.zh: 我们上个月开始使用这个方法。

grammar_examples.en: The book that changed my mind was quite short.
grammar_examples.zh: 那本改变了我想法的书其实很薄。

grammar_examples.en: My tutor, who lives in Leeds, records every session.
grammar_examples.zh: 我的导师住在利兹，他会录下每节课。

grammar_examples.en: The proposal was rejected without public scrutiny.
grammar_examples.zh: 该提案未经公众审查就被否决了。

grammar_examples.en: New words are added to the deck every morning.
grammar_examples.zh: 每天早上都有新词被加入卡组。

grammar_examples.en: Reading aloud is more effective than reading silently.
grammar_examples.zh: 朗读比默读更有效。

grammar_examples.en: This is the hardest chapter in the book.
grammar_examples.zh: 这是全书最难的一章。

grammar_examples.en: Small changes can mitigate the damage.
grammar_examples.zh: 小的改变可以减轻损害。

grammar_examples.en: She must have forgotten the deadline.
grammar_examples.zh: 她一定是忘了截止日期。

grammar_examples.en: She wrote a paper on the effects of sleep.
grammar_examples.zh: 她写了一篇关于睡眠影响的论文。

grammar_examples.en: The sun rose before we reached the station.
grammar_examples.zh: 我们到车站前太阳就升起来了。

grammar_examples.en: He was reluctant to admit the mistake.
grammar_examples.zh: 他不愿承认那个错误。

grammar_examples.en: We need time to sustain this routine.
grammar_examples.zh: 我们需要时间来维持这个习惯。

grammar_examples.en: In light of the results, we changed the plan.
grammar_examples.zh: 鉴于这些结果，我们改变了计划。

grammar_examples.en: Take your energy level into account before scheduling.
grammar_examples.zh: 安排时间前，先把你的精力水平考虑进去。

grammar_examples.en: The data was incomplete; nevertheless, the trend was clear.
grammar_examples.zh: 数据并不完整；尽管如此，趋势是清楚的。

grammar_examples.en: Although the task was short, it required full attention.
grammar_examples.zh: 虽然任务很短，但需要全神贯注。

grammar_mistakes.reason: yesterday 是明确过去时间，需用一般过去时。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: He has went to the library.
grammar_mistakes.correct: He has gone to the library.
grammar_mistakes.reason: have/has 后必须接过去分词，go 的过去分词是 gone。
did 已承担过去时标记，主要动词回到原形。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: The man which called you is my uncle.
grammar_mistakes.correct: The man who called you is my uncle.
grammar_mistakes.reason: 指人时用 who（作宾语可用 whom/that），不用 which。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: Beijing, that is the capital, is cold in winter.
grammar_mistakes.correct: Beijing, which is the capital, is cold in winter.
grammar_mistakes.reason: 非限定性定语从句不能用 that。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: The problem was happen last night.
grammar_mistakes.reason: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态。
better 本身已是比较级，不能叠加 more。
情态动词没有人称和数的变化。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: He is best student in class.
grammar_mistakes.correct: He is the best student in the class.
grammar_mistakes.reason: 最高级前需加 the；class 在此为特指。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: I look forward to see you.
grammar_mistakes.correct: I look forward to seeing you.
grammar_mistakes.reason: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: In light of improve the accuracy...
grammar_mistakes.correct: In light of improving the accuracy...
grammar_mistakes.reason: 介词后接名词性成分，动词需变为动名词。

grammar_mistakes.wrong: The plan was good, it failed anyway.
grammar_mistakes.correct: The plan was good, but it failed anyway.
grammar_mistakes.reason: 两个完整句之间需要连词或分号。

exercises.instruction: 把词块排成一句通顺的话
exercises.explanation: In light of ... 作状语前置，主句用现在完成时。
exercises.payload_json: {"tokens":["we have decided","In light of the new data,","on Thursday","to hold the meeting"],"answer":["In light of the new data,","we have decided","to hold the meeting","on Thursday"]}

exercises.instruction: 把词块排成一句通顺的话
exercises.explanation: 被动语态 was designed to ... 后接目的不定式。
exercises.payload_json: {"tokens":["how quickly new words","The study","are forgotten","was designed to measure"],"answer":["The study","was designed to measure","how quickly new words","are forgotten"]}

exercises.instruction: 改正句子中的一处语法错误
exercises.explanation: 指人的先行词用 who，不能用 which。
exercises.payload_json: {"wrong":"The man which called you is my uncle.","answer":"The man who called you is my uncle.","errorTag":"关系词选择"}

exercises.instruction: 改正句子中的一处语法错误
exercises.explanation: better 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。
exercises.payload_json: {"wrong":"This method is more better than the old one.","answer":"This method is better than the old one.","errorTag":"双重比较"}

exercises.instruction: 改正句子中的一处语法错误
exercises.explanation: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动形式。
exercises.payload_json: {"wrong":"The problem was happened last night.","answer":"The problem happened last night.","errorTag":"不及物动词被动化"}

exercises.instruction: 改正句子中的一处语法错误
exercises.explanation: 两个完整句之间需要连词或分号，不能只用逗号。
exercises.payload_json: {"wrong":"The plan was good, it failed anyway.","answer":"The plan was good, but it failed anyway.","errorTag":"逗号粘连"}

exercises.instruction: 把句子改写为被动语态
exercises.explanation: 把主动句改为被动句时，宾语提前，动词变 be + 过去分词。
exercises.payload_json: {"source":"The committee rejected the proposal without public scrutiny.","instruction":"改为被动语态","answer":"The proposal was rejected without public scrutiny.","references":["The proposal was rejected by the committee without public scrutiny."]}

exercises.instruction: 用定语从句合并两个句子
exercises.explanation: 把两个简单句合并为非限定性定语从句，用逗号 + which。
exercises.payload_json: {"source":"Reading aloud improves retention. This surprised the researchers.","instruction":"合并为一句定语从句","answer":"Reading aloud improves retention, which surprised the researchers.","references":["Reading aloud improves retention, which was surprising to the researchers."]}

exercises.instruction: 跟着示范朗读这句话
exercises.explanation: 注意 was going to 的弱读，以及 before 与 the 的连读。
exercises.payload_json: {"text":"I was going to grab a coffee before the session.","translation":"我本来打算在上课前买杯咖啡。","chunks":["I was going to","grab a coffee","before the session"],"targetSeconds":4}

exercises.instruction: 跟着示范朗读这句话
exercises.explanation: must 重读，before the release 整块连读，不要逐词停顿。
exercises.payload_json: {"text":"The team must mitigate the risk before the release.","translation":"团队必须在发布前降低风险。","chunks":["The team must","mitigate the risk","before the release"],"targetSeconds":4}

exercises.instruction: 跟着示范朗读这句话
exercises.explanation: 长句要按意群停顿，which is why 前换气。
exercises.payload_json: {"text":"Small habits accumulate into visible progress, which is why consistency matters more than intensity.","translation":"微小的习惯会积累成可见的进步，这正是坚持比强度更重要的原因。","chunks":["Small habits accumulate","into visible progress,","which is why consistency","matters more than intensity"],"targetSeconds":8}

exercises.instruction: 根据情景回应对方的每一句话
exercises.context: 你在和同事确认会议改期
exercises.explanation: 改期会议时，先给出理由，再提出替代方案，最后确认。
exercises.payload_json: {"scenario":"同事通知你会议需要改到周四下午，你需要确认时间并说明你的安排。","turns":[{"id":"t1","speaker":"ai","en":"Hi, quick heads-up — we may need to move Thursday's meeting.","zh":"嗨，先说一句，周四的会议可能要改时间。"},{"id":"t2","speaker":"user","en":"","zh":"回应：询问改到几点，并说明你下午三点前有空。","expected":["What time","I'm free before three","afternoon"]},{"id":"t3","speaker":"ai","en":"How about two thirty? We only need twenty minutes.","zh":"两点半怎么样？我们只需要二十分钟。"},{"id":"t4","speaker":"user","en":"","zh":"回应：确认时间，并提出会前把材料发给大家。","expected":["Two thirty works","send the materials","before the meeting"]}]}

exercises.instruction: 根据情景回应对方的每一句话
exercises.context: 你在车站询问去机场的列车
exercises.explanation: 问路时用 Could you tell me whether ... 比直接问更礼貌。
exercises.payload_json: {"scenario":"你在车站找去机场的列车，需要确认站台和发车时间。","turns":[{"id":"t1","speaker":"ai","en":"Good morning, how can I help you?","zh":"早上好，有什么可以帮您？"},{"id":"t2","speaker":"user","en":"","zh":"回应：询问去机场的列车是否从这个站台出发。","expected":["Could you tell me","airport","platform"]},{"id":"t3","speaker":"ai","en":"Yes, platform four. It leaves in about ten minutes.","zh":"是的，四号站台。大约十分钟后发车。"},{"id":"t4","speaker":"user","en":"","zh":"回应：道谢，并确认这趟车是否直达。","expected":["Thank you","direct","airport"]}]}

exercises.instruction: 判断斜体词的词性
exercises.explanation: rapid 修饰名词 growth，作定语，因此是形容词。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"the ___ growth of online learning（rapid 的词性）","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"形容词","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"副词","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"名词","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"动词","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 判断斜体词的词性
exercises.explanation: scrutiny 由形容词 scrutinous 派生，本身是不可数名词。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"survived public ___（scrutiny 的词性）","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"名词","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"动词","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"形容词","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"副词","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 这句话最可能出现在什么场景？
exercises.context: We took your schedule into account when planning the sessions.
exercises.explanation: take into account 最常出现在决策、规划类语境中。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"We took your schedule into account when planning the sessions.","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"工作安排与协商","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"餐厅点单","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"体育解说","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"诗歌朗诵","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 哪句话使用 ubiquitous 最自然？
exercises.explanation: ubiquitous 常用于描述技术、现象在社会中的普及，语域偏学术与媒体。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"选择最自然的用法","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"Smartphones are now ubiquitous in urban life.","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"My coffee is ubiquitous this morning.","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"He ubiquitous walked to school.","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"The ubiquitous of the room was small.","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 选择正确的时态
exercises.explanation: for three years 表示持续到现在，需要用现在完成进行或现在完成时。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"She ____ English for three years.","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"has been learning","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"learned","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"learns","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"is learning","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 选择正确的冠词
exercises.context: ____ sun rose before we reached the station.
exercises.explanation: 独一无二的天体前用 the。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"____ sun rose before we reached the station.","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"The","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"A","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"An","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"不填","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 选择正确的介词
exercises.explanation: depend on 是固定搭配，不能换成 depend of。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"Success depends ____ consistent review.","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"on","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"of","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"to","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"for","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 指出划线部分是哪种从句
exercises.context: The book **that changed my mind** was quite short.
exercises.explanation: 句中含有两个谓语（was、changed），that 引导定语从句修饰 the book。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"The book that changed my mind was quite short.","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"定语从句","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"宾语从句","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"状语从句","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"主语从句","correct":false}]}

exercises.instruction: 指出划线部分是哪种从句
exercises.explanation: which 指代前面整句内容，属于非限定性定语从句。
exercises.payload_json: {"stem":"He arrived late, which annoyed everyone.","options":[{"id":"o1","label":"非限定性定语从句","correct":true},{"id":"o2","label":"限定性定语从句","correct":false},{"id":"o3","label":"结果状语从句","correct":false},{"id":"o4","label":"同位语从句","correct":false}]}

assessment_modules.title: 词汇测试
assessment_modules.subtitle: Vocabulary Test
assessment_modules.description: 从词汇量、词义、词性、拼写到使用场景，五个分项给出一个可解释的词汇画像，而不是一个孤立分数。

assessment_modules.title: 语法测试
assessment_modules.subtitle: Grammar Test
assessment_modules.description: 覆盖时态、句子结构、纠错、介词冠词与从句识别。结果会指出具体薄弱结构，而不只是正确率。

assessment_modules.title: 口语测试
assessment_modules.subtitle: Speaking Test
assessment_modules.description: 朗读、语音输入、复述与情景表达四段评估。当前阶段使用文本输入模拟语音识别，接口已为真实音频预留。

assessment_sections.title: 词汇量估计
assessment_sections.description: 按频率分层抽样，估计你的可识别词汇量。

assessment_sections.title: 词义理解
assessment_sections.description: 在真实语境中选出最贴切的词。

assessment_sections.title: 词性判断
assessment_sections.description: 识别词在句中的语法角色。

assessment_sections.title: 拼写测试
assessment_sections.description: 根据释义写出完整拼写。

assessment_sections.title: 使用场景
assessment_sections.description: 判断词语最自然的语域与场景。

assessment_sections.title: 时态判断
assessment_sections.description: 根据时间标记选择正确的时态。

assessment_sections.title: 句子结构
assessment_sections.description: 把词块还原为符合语法与逻辑的句子。

assessment_sections.title: 语法纠错
assessment_sections.description: 找出并改正句子中的错误。

assessment_sections.title: 介词与冠词
assessment_sections.description: 固定搭配与冠词选择的稳定性测试。

assessment_sections.title: 从句识别
assessment_sections.description: 判断从句类型与关系词的适用条件。

assessment_sections.title: 朗读测试
assessment_sections.description: 按意群朗读，系统评估节奏与完整度。

assessment_sections.title: 语音输入
assessment_sections.description: 说出你听到的句子，系统转写后比对。

assessment_sections.title: 句子复述
assessment_sections.description: 看中文复述英文原句，检验工作记忆。

assessment_sections.title: 情景表达
assessment_sections.description: 在具体场景中组织完整回应。

assessment_sections.title: 口语能力评估
assessment_sections.description: 汇总以上四项，给出分级与改进建议。
